info.title: Engagement Intelligence Platform API
info.description: Backend API for the HOPE Engagement Intelligence Platform — student engagement tracking, assessments, attendance, feedback, risk scoring, and intervention management.

BearerAuth.description: JWT access token obtained from POST /auth/login

200.description: Login successful — returns access token, refresh token set as httpOnly cookie

post.summary: Refresh access token using httpOnly refresh token cookie

200.description: New access token issued, refresh token rotated

post.summary: Logout — revokes refresh token family and clears cookie
Activate account with token and set password

200.description: If account exists, activation email re-sent (generic response to prevent enumeration)
If account exists, reset email sent (generic response)

get.description: Returns users visible to the requester based on their RBAC scope.

patch.description: Requires users:change_role. Cannot change own role. Only ADMIN can assign ADMIN role.
Requires users:activate. Deactivating revokes all refresh tokens.
Requires users:recover_account. Issues activation or reset token depending on user status.

post.description: Requires users:create. CSV format: name,email,department,year (header row required). Users created as STUDENT with PENDING status.

delete.description: Blocked if batch has sessions or assessments.
Blocked if session has attendance or feedback.

sections.description: If weightages provided, all sections must have them totaling 100%.

post.description: CSV columns: studentId, questionId, score. Returns 207 on partial success.
